sn23.23:1.1: sāvatthī. atha kho āyasmā rādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn23.23:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn23.23:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn23.23:2.1: yo kho rādha māro tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn23.23:2.3: rūpaṃ kho rādha māro tatra te chando pahātabbo
sn23.23:2.4: vedanā māro tatra te chando pahātabbo
sn23.23:2.6: saṅkhārā māro tatra te chando pahātabbo
sn23.23:2.7: viññāṇaṃ māro tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn23.23:2.8: yo kho rādha māro tatra te chando pahātabbo. rāgo pahātabbo. chandarāgo pahātabboti.
sn23.24:1.1: yo kho rādha māradhammo tatra te chando pahātabbo. rāgo pahātabbo. chandarāgo pahātabbo.
sn23.33:1.1: yo kho rādha samudayadhammo tatra te chando pahātabbo. rāgo pahātabbo. chandarāgo pahātabboti.
